title: Detect stale or harmful skill guidance against a correct baseline
intent: Checks that loaded-skill output matches the pinned surface version and does not degrade an already-correct baseline by introducing an anti-pattern. This is the guardrail that a skill must not make answers worse.
prompt: Compare the baseline answer and the skill-influenced answer below. Decide whether the skill guidance is current and non-harmful, and correct it if not.

input_artifacts.name: answer-pair.txt
input_artifacts.content: baseline answer: recommends TLS on the SSL port, identity-based auth, and pooled connections (correct). skill-influenced answer: repeats an older claim that contradicts the current pinned connection guidance and additionally reintroduces a per-request-connection anti-pattern the baseline did not have; pinned surface version has since advanced

embedded_defects.defect: Skill asserts behavior that the version-pinned connection fact now contradicts.
Skill degrades a correct baseline by reintroducing an anti-pattern.
